article.title: Atlanta faces Charlotte for conference matchup
article.linkText: Atlanta faces Charlotte for conference matchup
article.story: Atlanta Hawks (1-0, second in the Eastern Conference) vs. Charlotte Hornets (1-0, sixth in the Eastern Conference) Charlotte, North Carolina; Friday, 7 p.m. EDT LINE: Hawks -2.5; over/under is 226.5 BOTTOM LINE: Charlotte faces Atlanta in a matchup of Eastern Conference teams. Charlotte went 44-38 overall and 26-26 in Eastern Conference action a season ago. The Hornets allowed opponents to score 111.2 points per game and shoot 46.7% from the field last season. Atlanta went 46-36 overall and 9-7 in Southeast Division action during the 2025-26 season. The Hawks averaged 30.1 assists per game on 43.6 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Hornets: Grant Williams: out (hamstring), Kylan Boswell: out (knee), Kon Knueppel: out (hamstring), Coby White: out (calf). Hawks: Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
